title: New Wave Radio - New Wave Radio Long

lines.l: Sunday morning, going slow, I'm talking to the radio
Clothes and records on the floor, the memories of the night before
Out in club land, having fun
And now I'm hiding from the sun
Waiting for a visitor, though
No one knows I'm here for sure
Dancing, laughing, drinking, loving
And now I'm all alone in Betsy's land, my only home
I think it's time to cook a meal to fill the emptiness I feel
Spend my money going outside, nothing in I'm left without
Clean my teeth and curl my hair and look for something new to wear
And start the nightlife over again and kid myself, I'm having fun
Dancing, laughing, drinking, loving
And now I'm all alone in bedside land, my only home
I look out from my window view, there's really nothing else to do
Read a book, maybe write a letter, but the things are getting better
Watch the mirror count the lines
The battle scars of all the good times
Look around and I can't see
A thousand people just like me
Dancing, laughing, drinking, loving
And now I'm all alone in bedside land, my only home
Dancing, laughing, I'm drinking
And now I'm all alone in bedside land, my only home
Dancing, laughing, I'm drinking
